rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being at home rather than away.

example.english: I usually watch dramas domestically on Sundays.
example.traditional: 星期日我通常喺屋企煲劇。
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hai2 uk1 kei2 bou1 kek6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a team or player competing on its own home ground.

example.english: We are playing domestically this time, and all the fans are cheering us on enthusiastically.
example.traditional: 我哋今場喺主場踢波，成班球迷都好落力咁打氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 hai2 zyu2 coeng4 tek3 bo1 sing4 baan1 kau4 mai4 dou1 hou2 lok6 lik6 gam3 daa2 hei3
